name: Pan-Fried Chicken with Cranberry-Orange Relish, Mixed Greens & Feta
ingredients: 1 ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Sprinkle both sides with flour and salt.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove chicken to a plate. (Reserve skillet with cooking juices for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Using a clean cutting board, peel and separate oranges into segments; cut segments crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Place in a small bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the orange and set aside.

When the chicken is done, return skillet (with cooking juices) to medium heat. Add orange, green onion, water, cranberries, coriander, and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until orange softens and relish has slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, place mixed greens, carrots, feta, and vinaigrette in a medium bowl. Gently toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide chicken and salad between plates; top chicken with orange relish. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
